notes: Several referee concerns (C8, C16, C20) reacted to figures or arguments in the Supplemental Material, which was not attached to arXiv v1. Even without the SM, the review identified the same underlying physical issues in the main text (e.g. for C16, that a 1D linear Dirac dispersion in Fig. 2b should give a flat plateau across the gap rather than a peak; for C20, that bulk/substrate states overlap the edge state energy; for C8, that the decay length should be extracted directly from the DFT nanoribbon LDOS), which are judged 'partly'.
